description: Canonical ownership and publication boundary for executable FOnline helper-script command lines.

scope.support_note: Helper command lines are revision-pinned implementation interfaces; automation must pin an engine revision.
included: engine-owned Python helper scripts that expose a top-level create_parser() factory
exact argparse usage, help output, arguments, subcommands, ownership, audience, and invocation context
excluded: the separately modeled BuildTools/buildtools.py command line
the separately modeled BuildTools/package.py command line and package declaration contract
documentation generators, tests, library-only modules, shell scripts, and embedding-project tools

helpers.name: Code generation
helpers.description: Generate engine configuration, metadata registration, script bindings, and embedded-resource source files.
helpers.usage:
usage: codegen.py [-h] -maincfg MAINCFG -buildhash BUILDHASH -devname DEVNAME
                  -nicename NICENAME -embedded EMBEDDED
                  -internalcfg INTERNALCFG [-enginedefine ENGINEDEFINE]
                  -meta META [-commonheader COMMONHEADER] -genoutput GENOUTPUT
                  [-verbose]
helpers.help_output:
usage: codegen.py [-h] -maincfg MAINCFG -buildhash BUILDHASH -devname DEVNAME
                  -nicename NICENAME -embedded EMBEDDED
                  -internalcfg INTERNALCFG [-enginedefine ENGINEDEFINE]
                  -meta META [-commonheader COMMONHEADER] -genoutput GENOUTPUT
                  [-verbose]

FOnline code generator

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -maincfg MAINCFG      main config file
  -buildhash BUILDHASH  build hash
  -devname DEVNAME      dev game name
  -nicename NICENAME    nice game name
  -embedded EMBEDDED    embedded buffer capacity
  -internalcfg INTERNALCFG
                        internal config buffer capacity
  -enginedefine ENGINEDEFINE
                        engine configuration define NAME=VALUE emitted as a
                        macro into EngineConfig.gen.h
  -meta META            path to script api metadata (///@ tags)
  -commonheader COMMONHEADER
                        path to common header file
  -genoutput GENOUTPUT  generated code output dir
  -verbose              verbose mode

global_arguments.description: engine configuration define NAME=VALUE emitted as a macro into EngineConfig.gen.h
path to script api metadata (///@ tags)
